description: Create a working form endpoint instantly for any email — no account needed. The owner claims it later via the claim_url. Returns the endpoint URL, claim_url, a ready-to-paste html_snippet, a curl_example, and a scoped api_key. This server remembers that key, so every other tool here (list_forms, get_submissions, configure_autoresponse, ...) works immediately afterwards without any human setup.

email.description: Email address of the future form owner (receives submission notifications)

name: instant_provision
